entities.summary: Soviet annexation of Western Ukraine (1939), Nazi invasion (1941) and brutal occupation, Babi Yar massacre (33,771 Jews shot in two days, September 1941), the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA), partisan warfare, the Volhynia tragedy, and liberation at the cost of 8 million Ukrainian lives.
